designSummary: Descriptive charting with frequencies and narrative summary; no pooling or significance testing.
sampleSize: No sample size applies; the prior scoping review charted 41 reports across specialties, so about 30 to 50 orthopaedic pathway reports are expected. With fewer than ten reports reporting times, times are summarised as ranges and medians of reported medians, not pooled.
primaryAnalysis: Frequency tables of screening points, triggers, leads and treatment locations; a figure of reported days from screening to surgery by screening point.
secondaryAnalysis: Narrative summary of provisions for distant patients and of patient-reported burdens; a table of reporting completeness.
missingData: Items not reported are charted as not reported and counted, never inferred.
software: Spreadsheet charting form and a reference manager.
overfittingGuards: No ranking of pathways by effectiveness
summary: Descriptive charting of about 30 to 50 reports; no pooling.
